description: § 38(c)(6)(A): $12,500 replaces $25,000 for a married person filing separately whose spouse has a business credit. Wages $200,000, $10,000 nonpassive credit, the spouse has a credit: tax $37,067 (MFS brackets match single here); line 13 = 25% x (37,067 − 12,500) = 6,141.75, but the tentative minimum tax 26% x 119,550 + 28% x (131,500 − 119,550) = 34,429 is larger: 37,067 − 34,429 = $2,638 allowed.
